title: FDs SkyBlock Low Fire
description:
Resourcepack modifying only player´s POV when on fire.
Lower fire, with less opacity, still visible for information of burning.
body:
**More visibility from your POV while on fire!
Lower fire from your POV.**

**Smaller, see-through but still visible.**

_This resource pack contains only fire animation changes, nothing else._
